{{Quote|Yoohoo! Do you like millaflowers? They're wonderful this time of year!|Mia Magansitty|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
The '''Millaflower''' was an especially aromatic flower from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], and one of their more exotic and lucrative exports.

==Physical characteristics==
Growing wild in isolated valleys on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the millaflower was a ground [[Flower/Legends|flower]] that came in several bright [[Color/Legends|colors]], with red and blue being the most common. Popular with the native [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], the flower was commonly cultivated in flower-boxes and [[Garden/Legends|gardens]], and when gifted was culturally considered to honor the recipient by signifying respect.

==Pharmacological uses==
Despite their great beauty, the millaflower was primarily valued for an [[Atmosphere/Legends|airborne]] chemical that they exuded, which caused most [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] breathing species to feel at ease. The more flowers concentrated in an area, the more pronounced this effect became - with a field of millaflowers in an enclosed space producing a mild tranquilizing effect. For this reason, the plant was very popular for use in aromatherapy.<ref name="NABOO" />

When extracted and distilled, this natural chemical becomes an organic [[tranquilizer]] with a bitter chalky flavor, powerful enough to [[Death/Legends|kill]] if administered in sufficient dosage. For this reason, Naboo law prohibits anyone but licensed drug manufacturers from producing the extract, and anyone but a licensed pharmacist from buying it. Prescribed by many homeopathic physicians, both plant and extract were a major Naboo export, with the doctors of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] commonly known to prescribe the extract for everything ranging from relaxation to muscle aches.<ref name="NABOO" />

==Illegal use==
[[File:Millaflowerpic.jpg|thumb|left|A field of millaflowers]]
Despite the flower's myriad uses, illicit uses existed as well. Most notably, the drug could be used to intentionally [[Poison/Legends|intoxicate]] or kill if administered in a high enough dose. Typically, those wishing to administer the drug secretly would use food or [[Wine/Legends|wine]] to mask the taste, though in doses of three or more, the taste was detectable regardless. Under the influence, onset could take up to an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], with a drugged [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] feeling a continual increase in well being until the full effects of the drug kicked in. In a standard [[Human/Legends|Human]], the full effects could be felt for up to ten hours, and varied in severity depending on dose. Commonly, a single dose produced relaxation, two made a sentient uninhibited, three doses intoxication, four doses a deep sleep and unconsciousness, five doses paralyzation, and six doses producing [[Heart/Legends|heart]] failure and death.<ref name="NABOO" />

In addition to the extract's potentially deadly use, some exported plants found their way into the hands of illicit drug manufacturers, who experimented with the extract as a potential [[spice]].<ref name="NABOO" />

==History==
Due to the dangerous nature of the plant, as well as its potential to be used as a spice, the millaflower went under review in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by a [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] subcommittee. Though, at the time, both plant and extract were legal everywhere, despite the extract being controlled on Naboo.<ref name="NABOO" />
